title: moduleTaskBrokerFiles
responsibility: Read and update exact assigned regular files for a trusted task host.

inputs.name: scope
inputs.description: Trusted canonical exclusive workspace and exact file grants.

inputs.name: writeBrokerFile.input
inputs.description: Assigned path, expected current SHA-256 and bounded UTF-8 replacement.

outputs.name: readBrokerFile
outputs.description: Reads at most 1 MiB from the assigned regular file.

outputs.name: writeBrokerFile
outputs.description: Serializes broker writes and updates the assigned file only if its current content digest matches.

errors.name: invalid grant, path, file, text or digest
errors.description: Reject symlink or hardlink paths and stale content. Host must provide exclusive workspace ownership; writes are not crash atomic.
